Truong My Linh

Chief Human Resources Officer (CHRO)

12 Jun 1985

(024) 66805588

hotro@topcv.vn

Thanh Xuan, Hanoi

Education

TopCV University

(

2010

-

2014

)

Bachelor of Human Resource Management

Graduated with Distinction

Skills

HR Strategy Development

Planning workforce, organizational structure, core competencies, and mid-to-long-term HR roadmap.

Performance Evaluation & Compensation System Development

Developing KPIs/OKRs aligned with business goals, designing fair compensation policies to retain key talent and optimize HR costs.

Change Management & HR Digital Transformation

Leading HRIS transformation initiatives, digitizing recruitment–evaluation–training processes to optimize performance and organizational adaptability.

Strategic Consulting & Executive Partnership

Ability to work closely with the CEO and Executive Board to provide strategic HR and organizational development consulting, ensuring human resources align with business growth objectives.

Certifications

2022

SHRM – Senior Certified Professional

2018

CIPD Level 5 – Associate Diploma in People Management

Interests
  • Reading books on management, organizational behavior, and people development
  • Joining HR-focused forums and professional seminars
  • Writing and sharing perspectives on HR profession via LinkedIn
Objective

Chief Human Resources Officer with over 10 years of experience in building HR systems for organizations ranging from 500 to 2000 employees. Strong in organizational restructuring, HR digital transformation, succession planning, and fostering sustainable corporate culture.


Successfully helped reduce fixed HR costs by 22% and increased employee satisfaction by 30% within 18 months. I aim to become a strategic partner to the CEO, accompanying the organization in its expansion and workforce optimization journey.

Work experience

NDS JSC – Technology Sector (2000+ employees)

Chief Human Resources Officer (CHRO)

2020

-

Present

  • Led end-to-end HR strategy from recruitment, compensation, and training to organizational development and corporate culture.
  • Restructured the HR and admin departments, optimizing operations and reducing 22% of fixed HR costs in the first year.
  • Implemented HRIS and OKRs systems to improve performance and enhance transparency in KPI evaluations.
  • Developed leadership succession programs, increasing internal management promotions from 40% to 70% over two years.
  • Partnered with CEO in strategic initiatives: M&A restructuring, post-M&A culture building, and human resource risk management.

NTD LLC – Retail & Chain Stores (500+ employees)

HR Manager

2018

-

2020

  • Managed HR operations for over 30 nationwide branches.
  • Developed a performance-based pay system (P4P), increasing labor productivity by 18% within 9 months.
  • Designed and implemented internal training programs for management levels, reducing voluntary turnover by 25% within a year.
  • Advised executive leadership during rapid expansion (10 branches/year), ensuring HR system stability.

DEF Group – Manufacturing Sector (1000+ employees)

General HR Officer → Recruitment Team Leader

2014

-

2018

  • Developed recruitment, evaluation, and training procedures for over 1000 factory workers.
  • Handled recruitment for technical, production, and office roles with 95% annual completion rate.
  • Implemented Kaizen in HR operations, reducing personnel document handling errors to under 1%.
  • Participated in the first HRIS implementation at the factory.
  • Collaborated with departments to develop a competency matrix for production staff, standardizing evaluations and career paths for 300+ workers.
Activities

HRBP Mentoring Circle Program

Mentor

2020

-

Present

  • Provided career orientation, practical experience sharing, and problem-solving skills for the new HR generation.

Seminar “HR Transformation in Digital Age”

Organizing Committee Member

2022

2024

  • Collaborated with experts to design content, invite speakers, and coordinate logistics for a specialized HR digital transformation event.
